assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished cozy mobile arcade game thumbnail, landscape 4:3 composition, no lettering or UI. Reference image is character identity reference ONLY: Pongi is this cute warm brown OTTER, round ears, cream muzzle and belly, large glossy black eyes, pink coral starfish hair clip, brown tapered tail; keep this identity, remove fishing rod. Pongi at bottom center holds a long wooden plank horizontally with both paws like a breakout paddle. Above him a white pearl ball bounces toward rows of chunky pastel sea-glass bricks in mint, butter yellow, peach and lavender; a cute blue-gray shark rushes down from upper side and two small torpedoes fire upward. Shallow turquoise sea background, soft foam, subtly sunlit, friendly adventure, painterly cartoon game illustration matching reference polished shading and dark warm outlines. Clear readable silhouette even in small arcade card, uncluttered, central subjects safe for cropping to 4:3 or square. No text, numbers, interface, watermarks, collage panels.
